name: v0.5.45
body:
## Changes

### Fixes
- Fix llama-server 'Invalid argument' error on Windows: strip quotes from file path arguments before passing to cmd /K
- TypeScript: applyOverrideFlag no longer wraps model/mmproj paths in double quotes
- Rust: new strip_path_quotes() function cleans quoted file paths (.gguf, .safetensors, .exe, etc.) in startup commands
